title: Numerous Foreign Ministers descending upon Rīga this week
summary_full: What is the collective noun for Foreign Ministers? A gaggle? A conclave? A diplomacy? Whatever, on 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, will be in full-on hostess mode as she welcomes no fewer than seven fellow Foreign Ministers to Rīga.
